penalties.details: Decision letter for levy of penalty
penalties.impact: Rs. 6,60,960 Penalty has been paid to the Exchange. During the last quarter, the Company was levied a penalty of Rs.4,34,200 plus applicable taxes by NSE vide letter dated February 27, 2026, for non‑compliance with the constitution of Committees as required under SEBI (LODR) Regulations. The Company’s request for waiver was rejected by NSE. Subsequently, in the current quarter, NSE issued a decision letter dated May 5, 2026, revising the penalty to Rs.6,12,000 plus applicable taxes. The Company duly paid the said amount of Rs.6,60,960 (inclusive of applicable taxes and after deduction of TDS) on May 16, 2026. The Company has since ensured compliance with the prescribed Committee constitution requirements.

During the last quarter, the Company was levied a penalty of Rs.4,34,200 plus applicable taxes by BSE vide mail dated February 27, 2026, for non‑compliance with the constitution of Committees during the IPO process and subsequent approvals, continuing until the 3rd March 2026 as required under SEBI (LODR) Regulations. Being NSE designated stock exchange penalty has been paid to NSE, as mentioned above.

Board extended timelines for Ghiloth capex, Mambattu expansion, and GCP utilization from March 31, 2026 to March 31, 2027.
Commercial production at Mambattu expansion plant commenced on April 29, 2026.
PEB capacity reached 147,122 MTPA following commercial production at one line of the Mambattu expansion on April 29, 2026.
PEB capacity reached 147,122 MTPA following commercial production at Mambattu expansion.
Received domestic PEB purchase order worth ₹165 Cr (excluding taxes) with a 4-month execution period.
Commenced commercial production of PEB structures (11,300 MTPA) and PUF panels (8,00,000 sq m/annum) at Ghiloth facility, Rajasthan on October 28, 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajay DD Singhania, Promoter of EPACK Prefab Technologies Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares held during FY2025-26 ending March 31, 2026.
EPack Prefab Technologies commenced commercial production at its new Mambattu plant in Andhra Pradesh on April 29, 2026.
EPACK Prefab issued a revised intimation clarifying the Mambattu plant address and detailing its 13,200 MT capacity addition.
EPack Prefab reported ₹145.20 Cr in unutilized IPO proceeds for Q4FY26 and extended project timelines to March 2027.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹470.8 Cr, net profit ₹30.29 Cr.
EPack Prefab reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,525.3 Cr and net profit of ₹92.6 Cr, alongside commercial production at its Mambattu expansion.
EPack Prefab reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,525.3 Cr and net profit of ₹92.6 Cr, driven by strong prefab growth and improved working capital.
EPack Prefab Technologies Limited disclosed audio recording of its May 18, 2026, analyst meet on its website.
EPack Prefab hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 18, 2026, reporting 35% revenue growth to ₹1,525 Cr and guiding for 30% prefab growth in FY27.
Sanjay Singhania, Promoter of EPACK Prefab Technologies Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares held during FY2026 ending March 31, 2026.
EPack Prefab received a domestic PEB purchase order worth ₹165 Cr on June 2, 2026.
EPACK Prefab commenced commercial production at its ₹100 Cr Ghiloth facility in Rajasthan, adding 11,300 MTPA PEB capacity.
